# Impossible Things in Workshop

Source: [5900](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/5900); edited 2025-05-07. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-5900-n1"></a>

- Archive lists missing direct capabilities: hiding most abilities, duplicating player-owned objects, directly adding effects to abilities, scaling abilities, and directly modifying weapon attack speed.

<a id="wiki-5900-n2"></a>

- It says player-owned objects such as BOB/turrets do not trigger relevant player events; barriers have invisibility/scaling exceptions.

Source limitations:

- Explicitly unfinished beginner article; broad impossibility claims are date-sensitive and need careful scoping.

- Scaling article9662 says certain abilities scale with players, qualifying this article's blanket ability-scaling claim beyond its barrier exception.
